rules: One semantic action has one interactive writer.
One current training fact has one authoritative store.
Compatibility bridges delegate; they do not regain authority.
A derived projection or resolver cannot create a second persistence model.
Flow intent may orchestrate existing owners but cannot become Encounter truth.
Changing an owner requires explicit handoff, regression proof, and retirement of the previous writer.
